description: Ministry of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports - Notify the re-registration of the National Association for Archery and cancelled the Gaz. Ex. No. 2068/25
reasoning: This gazette notification cancels a previous gazette and issues a directive under the Sports Act No. 25 of 1973. The content involves the legal revocation and re-registration of a national sports association, which constitutes a regulatory matter under existing legislation. While a minister is named, the primary purpose is to execute and modify a legal/regulatory framework (the Sports Act), not to announce a personnel change or detail ministerial portfolio responsibilities. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "legal notices."
